title: SeCoS (Semantic Conceptual Structure): code and data for "Mapping sports injury research using bibliometric and embedding-based analysis"
description: R scripts, the documented function secos() and derived data that reproduce every number, table and figure of the article "Mapping sports injury research using bibliometric and embedding-based analysis" (G. Zammarchi and C. Pisanu, Computational Statistics) and of its Supplementary Material. The Web of Science records are not distributed; their identifiers are. The code is released under the MIT License and the data files under CC BY 4.0 (see README.md).
